title: 3rd Density Overlays
subtitle: Test your understanding of 3rd-density overlays — density suppression, projected frequencies, and the architecture of the simulated realm.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: 3rd Density Overlays are the frequency blankets that hide the original crystalline architecture of this realm. Every correct answer peels back another layer of projected illusion. Sit with what you missed, then return to the deep-dive, infographics, and video transmissions. Recognizing overlays is how you begin to see through the dimmer switch of density suppression before the final restoration.

options.label: B
options.text: Density Node 1, presented as if it were the natural or official account of events
options.rationale: Nodes are specific junction points on the energy grid, not the name for the entire physical plane.

options.label: C

options.rationale: The physical plane is the tenth gateway of existence, which was taken over and inverted to serve as a prison simulation.

options.label: D
options.text: The Crystalline Matrix, which collapses once the inverted timeline and harvest.
options.rationale: The crystalline lattice refers to the energetic network of the realm rather than the specific gateway designation of the physical plane.
